result.summary: Wrote docs/agents/design/REQ-015.md. requireOrganizerForChapter runs first in every mutation, structurally guaranteeing zero side effects on refusal. AuditLog write is atomic (same db.transaction as the mutation), guaranteeing exactly-once-on-success/zero-on-failure structurally. Stateless single-command flow, no new grammY plugin. Correctly deferred the future-events-snapshot mechanism to REQ-016 since no Event CRUD exists yet, and flagged a real RESTRICT-FK tension for REQ-016 to reconcile (currently unreachable). 6 open questions listed explicitly.
